name: huddle
about: A fresh network has no channel: the walk makes its own (qa-huddle-<walk_tag>), then starts a huddle in it and leaves it. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 call/src/panel.rs:398-416 — who is speaking is shown only by initials colour
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 call/src/panel.rs:305,382 — video tiles and the stage are unlabelled images: not in the tree
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 call — mute shows only as the name flip Mute / Unmute, no toggled state
app/src/shell.rs:3038-3052 — the voice dock says Voice connected, the time and the room in plain text: not in the tree; its Open button is a vague name
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 chat/src/ui/chat.rs:332-343 — Start a huddle lives in the room header and shows only while a channel is open: on a fresh network there is none until one is made

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Chat tab is selected and the chat view shows a New channel button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: press New channel in the chat sidebar
steps.expect: a Create a channel card shows: a Channel name field, Voice room: Off and Members only: Off buttons, and Cancel and Create channel buttons

steps.say: type the channel name into the Channel name field
steps.expect: the Channel name field's value is qa-huddle-{param:walk_tag} and Create channel is enabled (its state does not list disabled)
the Create a channel card is gone and the channel list shows a button named for qa-huddle-{param:walk_tag} (a leading # is fine); no error sentence

steps.say: press the qa-huddle-{param:walk_tag} channel in the channel list
steps.expect: the room header's name label reads qa-huddle-{param:walk_tag} and the composer shows a Send button and, in the room header, a Start a huddle button
the huddle started: the chat header shows Leave huddle and Show huddle, or the rail shows Mute and Leave voice controls; no error

steps.say: press Leave (the rail voice control) or Leave huddle
steps.expect: the huddle ended: the rail's Mute and Leave voice controls are gone and the chat header offers Start a huddle again

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it
